text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Each model was trained once, on one year of data. Dot: mean. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. The control member arms use all 51 ensemble members; the ERA5 arms have one weather value per time.'
text.tspan: 13 primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026.
Each model was trained once, on one year of data.
Dot: mean. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. The control member
arms use all 51 ensemble members; the ERA5 arms have one weather value per time.
